title: SFDR agreement could be struck next week, say EU legislators
lede: RI understands agreement has been reached on sovereign debt, while a sticking point remains on oil and gas safeguards.

title: EU Commission to host security talks after week of bomb hoaxes that hit 20 airports and dozens of European flights
lede: Experts from EU member states will meet on Wednesday to discuss last week’s bomb hoaxes affecting dozens of flights across Europe and causing millions in losses.

title: Japan urged to ditch fossil fuel support to maximise clean-tech exports
lede: Japan could be one of the big winners of Asia's electrification push, but it must radically pivot its policies away from propping up fossil fuels, a new analysis says The post Japan urged to ditch fossil fuel support to maximise clean-tech exports appeared first on Climate Home News .

title: As many Russians killed near Pokrovsk in Ukraine as Soviet troops killed in the 1945 Battle of Berlin, according to hacked data (Ukraine Battlefield update, Day 1,720)
lede: The data leak reveals a war so costly that battles around Pokrovsk now rival some of the most arrowing clashes of WW2, potentially reshaping how Moscow and Kyiv — as well as their allies — calculate their next moves on the front.
